natural: Bending the chimney and moving the firewood

meaning.en: To take precautions to prevent disaster.
meaning.zh: 把烟囱改建成弯的，把灶旁的柴草搬走。比喻事先采取措施，防止危险发生。

examples.zh: 安全工作要曲突徙薪，防患于未然。
examples.en: Safety work means taking precautions before disaster strikes.

examples.zh: 提出曲突徙薪建议的人往往得不到重视。
examples.en: Those who warn of danger in advance often go unheeded.

story.en: A guest advised a host to bend his chimney and move the firewood. The host ignored him; his house caught fire. He rewarded the neighbours who put it out but forgot the man who had warned him.
story.zh: 客人劝主人把烟囱改弯、搬走柴草，主人不听，后来失火。主人宴请救火的邻居，却没请提建议的人。

natural: The leather bindings breaking three times

meaning.en: To study a book so diligently that it wears out.
meaning.zh: 编联竹简的皮绳断了三次。比喻读书勤奋。

examples.zh: 孔子读《易》，韦编三绝。
examples.en: Confucius read the Book of Changes until its bindings broke three times.

examples.zh: 他研读这本经典，可谓韦编三绝。
examples.en: He studied that classic until it was falling apart.

story.en: In old age Confucius loved the Book of Changes so much that the leather thongs binding its bamboo slips broke three times.
story.zh: 孔子晚年喜读《易》，"读《易》，韦编三绝"。

usage.zh: 多作谓语。"韦"指熟牛皮绳。

natural: Rain pouring as if from a tipped basin

meaning.en: A downpour; torrential rain.
meaning.zh: 雨大得像从盆里倒出来的一样。形容雨大势急。

examples.zh: 突然下起了倾盆大雨。
examples.en: Suddenly it started bucketing down.

examples.zh: 在倾盆大雨中，他们仍坚持比赛。
examples.en: They kept playing in the torrential rain.

usage.en: Noun phrase; object of 下起.

natural: Rare delicacies and fine dishes

meaning.en: Rare delicacies; sumptuous food.
meaning.zh: 珍奇名贵的美味食品。

examples.zh: 宴席上摆满了珍馐美馔。
examples.en: The banquet was laden with delicacies.

examples.zh: 再多的珍馐美馔也比不上妈妈做的菜。
examples.en: No gourmet feast beats Mum's cooking.

usage.en: Subject or object. 馐 xiū, 馔 zhuàn.

natural: Steering by the wind

meaning.en: To trim one's sails to the wind; opportunistic.
meaning.zh: 看风向转发动舵柄。比喻看情势或别人的眼色行事。

equivalents: go whichever way the wind blows

examples.zh: 他很会见风使舵，谁得势就跟谁。
examples.en: He trims his sails to the wind and follows whoever's in power.

examples.zh: 做人要有原则，不能见风使舵。
examples.en: Have principles — don't just go whichever way the wind blows.

usage.en: Predicate. Derogatory. Also 看风使舵.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，贬义。也作"看风使舵"。

natural: Capturing seven times and releasing seven times

meaning.en: To win someone over by patience and magnanimity.
meaning.zh: 比喻运用策略，使对方心服。

examples.zh: 诸葛亮七擒七纵孟获，使其心悦诚服。
examples.en: Zhuge Liang captured and released Meng Huo seven times, winning his loyalty.

examples.zh: 对待犯错的学生要有七擒七纵的耐心。
examples.en: With students who misbehave, you need patience to win them over.

origin.source: 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》裴松之注引《汉晋春秋》

story.en: Zhuge Liang captured the southern chieftain Meng Huo seven times and released him seven times, until Meng swore never to rebel again.
story.zh: 诸葛亮南征，七次捉住孟获又七次放了他，孟获终于心服，表示不再反叛。

usage.en: Predicate or subject. Also 七纵七擒.

natural: So wasted by grief that only bones remain

meaning.en: Emaciated with grief (especially mourning a parent).
meaning.zh: 旧时形容在父母丧中因过度悲伤而瘦得只剩骨架。

examples.zh: 母亲去世后，他哀毁骨立。
examples.en: After his mother died, he wasted away with grief.

examples.zh: 古人守孝，常常哀毁骨立。
examples.en: In ancient mourning, people often wasted away with grief.

story.en: Wang Rong and He Qiao both lost parents. Wang lay on a bed wasted to bones (鸡骨支床) while He Qiao wailed by the rites; the emperor was told Wang's grief was deeper.
story.zh: 王戎、和峤同时遭大丧，王戎"鸡骨支床"，和峤"哭泣备礼"，时人认为王戎"哀毁骨立"。

natural: Complete, good and undamaged

meaning.en: Intact; undamaged.
meaning.zh: 完整无缺，没有损坏。

examples.zh: 快递包装得很好，东西完好无损。
examples.en: The parcel was well packed and arrived intact.

examples.zh: 地震后这座古塔完好无损。
examples.en: The ancient pagoda came through the earthquake unscathed.

natural: Secretly thanking one's lucky stars

meaning.en: To secretly feel relieved or lucky.
meaning.zh: 私下里为自己的幸运而感到高兴。

examples.zh: 看到车祸现场，他暗自庆幸自己没赶上那班车。
examples.en: Seeing the crash, he thanked his lucky stars he'd missed that bus.

examples.zh: 考题正好是复习过的，我暗自庆幸。
examples.en: The exam questions were ones I'd revised — I was quietly relieved.

usage.en: Predicate. A descriptive 四字词语.

natural: Wasting lips and tongue in vain

meaning.en: To waste one's breath.
meaning.zh: 白白地浪费口舌。指说话没有效果。

examples.zh: 他根本不听，你说了也是白费唇舌。
examples.en: He won't listen — you'd be wasting your breath.

examples.zh: 跟他讲道理简直是白费唇舌。
examples.en: Reasoning with him is like talking to a brick wall.

natural: A clumsy mouth and awkward tongue

meaning.en: Inarticulate; not good with words.
meaning.zh: 形容口才不好，不善言辞。

examples.zh: 我笨嘴拙舌的，不会说话，请多包涵。
examples.en: I'm not good with words — please bear with me.

examples.zh: 他笨嘴拙舌，但做事很踏实。
examples.en: He's inarticulate but very reliable.

usage.en: Predicate. Often self-deprecating. Also 笨口拙舌.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常作谦辞。也作"笨口拙舌"。

natural: Stirring up rights and wrongs

meaning.en: To stir up trouble by spreading gossip.
meaning.zh: 搬弄口舌，挑拨离间，制造纠纷。

examples.zh: 她喜欢搬弄是非，同事都躲着她。
examples.en: She loves stirring up trouble, so colleagues avoid her.

examples.zh: 有人在背后搬弄是非，破坏团结。
examples.en: Someone is sowing discord behind the scenes.

usage.en: Predicate. Also written 播弄是非.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"播弄是非"。

natural: A tree of no use as timber

meaning.en: A useless person or thing (sometimes the useless survive best).
meaning.zh: 不成材的树木。比喻无用之人，也比喻因无用而得以保全。

examples.zh: 他自称不材之木，其实很有才华。
examples.en: He calls himself useless, but he's actually very talented.

examples.zh: 庄子说，不材之木能尽其天年。
examples.en: Zhuangzi said a tree of no use lives out its full years.

story.en: Zhuangzi saw woodcutters ignore a great tree because its wood was useless. He said: "Because it is useless, this tree can live out its natural years."
story.zh: 庄子见伐木者不砍一棵大树，因为它"无所可用"。庄子说："此木以不材得终其天年。"

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

natural: Not good with words

meaning.en: Not good at expressing oneself.
meaning.zh: 不擅长说话表达。

examples.zh: 他不善言辞，但心地善良。
examples.en: He's not much of a talker, but he has a kind heart.

examples.zh: 我不善言辞，就用行动表达感谢吧。
examples.en: I'm not good with words, so let my actions say thank you.

natural: Creative thought dried up

meaning.en: To run out of creative ideas; writer's block.
meaning.zh: 写作的才情和思路已经用尽。

examples.zh: 连续写了三本书，他感到才思枯竭。
examples.en: After three books in a row, he hit writer's block.

examples.zh: 才思枯竭的时候，不妨出去走走。
examples.en: When you run out of ideas, try going for a walk.

natural: Charging and breaking the enemy ranks

meaning.en: To charge into battle; to take the lead bravely.
meaning.zh: 向敌人冲击，深入敌人阵地。形容作战勇敢，也泛指勇往直前。

equivalents: in the thick of the fight

examples.zh: 战士们冲锋陷阵，英勇杀敌。
examples.en: The soldiers charged into battle bravely.

examples.zh: 在疫情一线，医护人员冲锋陷阵。
examples.en: On the front line of the pandemic, medical staff led from the front.

natural: A foul name known to all

meaning.en: Notorious; infamous.
meaning.zh: 坏名声人人都知道。

examples.zh: 这个黑帮头目臭名昭著。
examples.en: The gang leader is notorious.

examples.zh: 那家公司因造假而臭名昭著。
examples.en: The company is infamous for fraud.

natural: Facing upheaval without alarm

meaning.en: To stay calm in a crisis.
meaning.zh: 面对变故时沉着镇定，不惊慌。

examples.zh: 他处变不惊，冷静处理了突发事件.
examples.en: He stayed unflappable and handled the emergency calmly.

examples.zh: 领导者要有处变不惊的素质。
examples.en: A leader needs grace under pressure.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 处 is chǔ.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"处"读 chǔ。

natural: Every inch of land worth an inch of gold

meaning.en: (Of land) extremely valuable.
meaning.zh: 一寸土地一寸金。形容土地价值极高。

examples.zh: 在市中心，每块地都寸土寸金。
examples.en: In the city centre, every plot is prime real estate.

examples.zh: 香港寸土寸金，房子很小。
examples.en: Land in Hong Kong is so valuable that flats are tiny.

natural: Not an inch of thread hanging

meaning.en: Stark naked; (Buddhist) free of all worldly attachment.
meaning.zh: 原为佛教用语，比喻不受尘俗牵挂。后形容赤身裸体。

examples.zh: 修行之人寸丝不挂，心无杂念。
examples.en: The practitioner is free of all ties, with a mind free of distraction.

examples.zh: 孩子洗完澡寸丝不挂地跑了出来。
examples.en: The child ran out stark naked after the bath.

usage.en: Predicate. Close to 一丝不挂.

natural: An inch of iron in hand

meaning.en: Having even a small weapon (or tool) at hand; the opposite of being defenceless.
meaning.zh: 手中有一点兵器。指有一定的防身或作战能力，与"手无寸铁"相对。

examples.zh: 寸铁在手，他心里踏实了许多。
examples.en: With a weapon in hand, he felt much safer.

examples.zh: 与手无寸铁的百姓不同，士兵寸铁在手。
examples.en: Unlike the defenceless civilians, the soldiers were armed.

usage.en: Predicate. Rare; mostly contrasted with 手无寸铁.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，较少用，常与"手无寸铁"对比。

natural: Urging people to strive forward

meaning.en: Inspiring; spurring people on.
meaning.zh: 促使人们振奋精神，努力向前。

examples.zh: 英雄的事迹催人奋进。
examples.en: The heroes' deeds are inspiring.

examples.zh: 这首歌旋律激昂，催人奋进。
examples.en: The song's rousing melody spurs people on.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Formal; speeches and reports.

natural: Surrounded by jade and pearls

meaning.en: Lavishly adorned with jewels; also surrounded by many attendants.
meaning.zh: 形容妇女妆饰华丽，也形容侍女众多。

examples.zh: 宴会上贵妇们翠绕珠围。
examples.en: The ladies at the banquet were dripping with jewels.

examples.zh: 她翠绕珠围地出现在众人面前。
examples.en: She appeared before everyone, lavishly bejewelled.

natural: Greatly satisfying the eyes

meaning.en: A feast for the eyes; to see something wonderful.
meaning.zh: 指看到了珍奇美好的事物，满足了眼睛的欲望。

examples.zh: 这次画展让我大饱眼福。
examples.en: The art exhibition was a real feast for the eyes.

examples.zh: 观众们大饱眼福，看了一场精彩的演出。
examples.en: The audience was treated to a spectacular show.

natural: Greatly satisfying the ears

meaning.en: A treat for the ears; to hear wonderful music.
meaning.zh: 指听到了美妙的声音，满足了耳朵的欲望。

examples.zh: 这场音乐会让我们大饱耳福。
examples.en: The concert was a real treat for the ears.

examples.zh: 听了这么多好歌，真是大饱耳福。
examples.en: So many great songs — music to my ears.

usage.en: Predicate. Modelled on 大饱眼福.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，仿"大饱眼福"而成。
